critique_summary: The fleet shows dangerous asset correlation across Kraken bots with identical losing positions in DYM, IMX, and RENDER. Navigator (Forex) is severely underperforming with a 16.7% win rate and extreme overconcentration in JPY shorts. Oracle is appropriately defensive in SGOV, but regime labeling (Crypto vs Bear) requires alignment.
